notes.title: Playtest signups now open!
notes.notes: [h1]Playtest signups are now open for Night Machine! [/h1][p][/p][p]Good news everyone, playtests signups are open! [/p][p][/p][p]Click [b]Request Access[/b] on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2974540/Night_Machine"]Night Machine Steam page[/url] to join the playtest queue. [/p][p][/p][p]We will be accepting requests on a rolling basis, and you'll receive an email from Steam as soon as you've been granted access. [/p][p][/p][p]Once accepted, you'll also be able to invite up to 3 of your friends to join the playtest immediately, so you can compare notes. [/p][p][/p][p]We're looking forward to letting the first group of players try out Night Machine, and hearing what you all have to say! [/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, you can join our [url="https://discord.gg/mEW7qr8QV6"]Discord[/url] to say hi, ask questions, and chat with the devs about the game. [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/mEW7qr8QV6" style="button" buttoncolor="#474747"]Night Machine Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010627/6e11aa3fc1ef05f6beaa2d635804c7608c4abddf.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Playtest opening soon!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hi everyone![/b]

Night Machine will begin accepting requests for access from playtesters [i]later this week[/i]! We'll approve players for access on a rolling basis.[/p][p][/p][p]Player feedback is essential to make a great game, and we're excited to hear what you have to say.[/p][p][/p][p]Come join our [url="https://discord.gg/mEW7qr8QV6"]Discord[/url] while you're waiting and say hi!
[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/mEW7qr8QV6" style="button" buttoncolor="#474747"]Night Machine Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010627/957d6f6a66068a9e7a95569043d6642111445832.png"][/img][/p]
